encode_file_id_with_model: encode a file or batch ID with model routing information using base64 encoding
decode_model_from_file_id: decode the model name from an encoded file or batch ID containing embedded routing info
get_original_file_id: extract the original provider file or batch ID from an encoded ID
handle_model_based_routing: orchestrate model-based credential routing for file operations using embedded or request model params
extract_file_creation_params: extract structured file creation parameters from a FastAPI request including storage and model names
is_gemini_supported_mime_type: test if a MIME type is supported by Gemini multimodal models for images, video, audio, and documents
update_batch_in_database: update batch status and object in the managed object database table
